lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabad milai bhau bha(n)jan har raavai masatak bhaago ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Shabad, one meets the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, and by the destiny written on her forehead, she enjoys Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਣਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: khetee vanaj sabh hukam hai hukame ma(n)n vadiaaee raam ||
lines.translation: All farming and trading is by Hukam of His Will; surrendering to the Lord's Will, glorious greatness is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee hukam boojheeai hukame mel milaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, one comes to understand the Lord's Will, and by His Will, he is united in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam milaaee sahaj samaaee gur kaa sabad apaaraa ||
lines.translation: By His Will, one merges and easily blends with Him. The Shabads of the Guru are incomparable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee vadiaaee gur te paaee sach savaaranahaaraa ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, true greatness is obtained, and one is embellished with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau bha(n)jan paaiaa aap gavaaiaa guramukh mel milaaee ||
lines.translation: He finds the Destroyer of fear, and eradicates his self-conceit; as Gurmukh, he is united in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak naam nira(n)jan agam agochar hukame rahiaa samaaee ||4||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the Name of the immaculate, inaccessible, unfathomable Commander is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man meriaa too sadaa sach samaal jeeu ||
lines.translation: O my mind, contemplate the True Lord forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanai ghar too sukh vasahi pohi na sakai jamakaal jeeu ||
lines.translation: Dwell in peace in the home of your own self, and the Messenger of Death shall not touch you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਜਾਲੁ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal jaal jam johi na saakai saachai sabad liv laae ||
lines.translation: The noose of the Messenger of Death shall not touch you, when you embrace love for the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sach rataa man niramal aavan jaan rahaae ||
lines.translation: Ever imbued with the True Lord, the mind becomes immaculate, and its coming and going is ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai bharam vigutee manamukh mohee jamakaal ||
lines.translation: The love of duality and doubt have ruined the self-willed manmukh, who is lured away by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahai naanak sun man mere too sadaa sach samaal ||1||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, listen, O my mind: contemplate the True Lord forever. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man meriaa a(n)tar terai nidhaan hai baahar vasat na bhaal ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭੁੰਚਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo bhaavai so bhu(n)ch too guramukh nadar nihaal ||
lines.translation: Eat only that which is pleasing to the Lord, and as Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh nadar nihaal man mere a(n)tar har naam sakhaaee ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, receive the blessing of His Glance of Grace, O my mind; the Name of the Lord, your help and support, is within you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhule giaan vihoone doojai bhaai khuaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are blind, and devoid of wisdom; they are ruined by the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai ko chhootai naahee sabh baadhee jamakaal ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, no one is emancipated. All are bound by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak a(n)tar terai nidhaan hai too baahar vasat na bhaal ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the treasure is within you; do not search for it on the outside. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man meriaa janam padaarath paai kai ik sach lage vaapaaraa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, obtaining the blessing of this human birth, some are engaged in the trade of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sevan aapanaa a(n)tar sabad apaaraa ||
lines.translation: They serve their True Guru, and the Infinite Word of the Shabad resounds within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sabad apaaraa har naam piaaraa naame nau nidh paaee ||
lines.translation: Within them is the Infinite Shabad, and the Beloved Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Naam, the nine treasures are obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਦੂਖਿ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh maaiaa moh viaape dookh sa(n)taape doojai pat gavaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; they suffer in pain, and through duality, they lose their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar sach sabad samaane sach rate adhikaaee ||
lines.translation: But those who conquer their ego, and merge in the True Shabad, are totally imbued with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak maanas janam dula(n)bh hai satigur boojh bujhaaee ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, it is so difficult to obtain this human life; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere satigur sevan aapanaa se jan vadabhaagee raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, those who serve their True Guru are the most fortunate beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo man maarahi aapanaa se purakh bairaagee raam ||
lines.translation: Those who conquer their minds are beings of renunciation and detachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan bairaagee sach liv laagee aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: They are beings of renunciation and detachment, who lovingly focus their consciousness on the True Lord; they realize and understand their own selves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਅਤਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat nihachal at gooRee guramukh sahaje naam vakhaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Their intellect is steady, deep and profound; as Gurmukh, they naturally chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੋਇ ਰਹੇ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik kaaman hitakaaree maaiaa mohi piaaree manamukh soi rahe abhaage ||
lines.translation: Some are lovers of beautiful young women; emotional attachment to Maya is very dear to them. The unfortunate self-willed manmukhs remain asleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sahaje sevahi gur apanaa se poore vadabhaage ||4||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who intuitively serve their Guru, have perfect destiny. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਵਣਜੀਅਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan padaarath vanajeeahi satigur deeaa bujhaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Purchase the jewel, the invaluable treasure; the True Guru has given this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹਾ ਲਾਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: laahaa laabh har bhagat hai gun mahi gunee samaaee raam ||
lines.translation: The profit of profits is the devotional worship of the Lord; one's virtues merge into the virtues of the Lord.
